rendering_rules.line_total_rule: The quote total must equal the sum of all line items. If the total exceeds the sum, the difference must appear as a line item with code ending in _OTHER. Any unexplained gap between the total and the sum of lines is a validation error.
rendering_rules.attachment_policy: A single PDF attachment up to 10 MB may be uploaded alongside the structured form as supplementary detail. The PDF is stored for HR reference but does not replace the structured fields. Structured fields are the authoritative record for comparison and policy checking.
